title: Bounded current-tree and reachable-history chat-dump audit

currentTree.scope: Tracked and nonignored untracked Git-visible regular files at the recorded snapshot; node_modules, ignored local state and .git internals are outside this file set.

filenameMatches.classification: Application demo ownership/session source, not conversation history.
Application sketch interaction source, not conversation history.

reachableHistory.method: Independent read-only Codex review of text blobs reachable from local Git references; no commit messages or private conversation text reproduced in this report.

signatureFamilies: Paired line-prefixed User/Human and Assistant dialogue markers.
limits: This is a bounded signature and candidate-classification audit, not proof that every unstructured prose conversation excerpt is absent.
Binary/non-UTF8 current files were not interpreted as text; reachable-history text review used the listed formats and limit.
Unreachable Git objects, ignored local files, external GitHub services, other repositories and the user's Codex history were not scanned.
Automated Node reporter events, test diagnostics and verification provenance are not user-assistant conversation transcripts.
This report is an audit artifact whose filename contains chat-history; it contains counts, paths, filters and limitations, not a chat transcript.
